Add a heavy rate limit (`RateLimit.EXPENSIVE_TOKEN`) to unauthorized admin endpoint requests to avoid brute force attacks

commits.author: jasonpyau
commits.message:
Fix experience warning and remove unneeded code

Fix a warning (HV000271) which logs that using `@Valid` on `java.util.Set` is deprecated, which was introduced in PR #17. Also remove unneeded code now that experience positions are updated with the `/experiences/{id}/positions/new` and `/experiences/{id}/positions/delete` endpoints instead of the `/experiences/update/{id}` endpoint.
